note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A disposable dust mask is an inadequate control for an unknown exposure. The case is flagged for a competent adviser.
The guidance says to wear a P2 face mask and protective clothing even when unsure whether asbestos is present. PPE is one part of the control set.

practicalCriteria: The learner rejects PPE that does not match the hazard, including a dust mask for unknown ash.
The learner links each PPE item to the hazard assessment and the employer's program.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: PPE does not match the characterised hazard, or fit and training are not verified.
A respirator is proposed for an uncharacterised residue.
